prompts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: polished desktop interface DESIGN PROPOSAL for Linko / 屏跃, a Chinese Windows/macOS LAN keyboard-and-mouse cooperation tool.
Input image1 is our original app-icon asset; use that exact linked-double-screen icon small at top-left. Create a BRAND NEW layout, not the earlier two-device-card dashboard.
Approved direction: porcelain white #F7F8FA canvas, white #FFFFFF surfaces, graphite #20252D primary text, gray-blue #5F6F85 secondary text, restrained brand blue #4263EB (hover #3651CC, selected soft #E8EEFF), hairline border #E2E7EF. Roughly85% neutral,10% brand,at most5% semantic accents. Contemporary native-desktop quality: learn from the restrained device-first clarity of Logi Options+, the type/spacing discipline of Linear, spatial topology of Synergy, and simple flow of LocalSend. Use original assets only. No mint/teal gradients, anime pink, colorful cards, ornamental metrics, giant decorative illustrations, dark sidebar slab, glassmorphism or glows.
Complete straight-on desktop app window, landscape~16:10 at1440x900 logical proportion. Crisp clean Simplified Chinese, 14–16px body, 26px title,12–16px panel radii,8–12px controls,thin borders, restrained shadows. Light narrow sidebar~190px, large central spatial SCREEN TOPOLOGY canvas, right contextual panel~280px. Keep meaningful whitespace, beautifully aligned edges and a single primary button. This is screen arrangement, NOT remote screen/video streaming.
Top-left icon + brand Linko, small 屏跃.
Sidebar Chinese entries 设备; 屏幕布局 SELECTED with only pale blue row and a thin blue edge; 文件传输 marked 尚未接通; 剪贴板 marked 尚未接通; 快捷键; 设置 at bottom. Small footer 开发预览.
Main heading 屏幕布局, supporting text 让屏幕的位置，和你的桌面一致。
Header right fixed quiet controls 停止协同 and 恢复本机, then outlined ＋ 添加电脑. All are secondary, not solid blue.
Main toolbar shows 主屏相对位置 and small neutral view tools − / 100% / ＋ / 适配画布. Topology only arranges TWO primary screens. NO invented actual resolutions, OS versions, latency, progress or more devices.
Main canvas occupies most of main area with a very subtle sparse neutral dot grid. Two medium landscape monitor-outline blocks, left 本机, with small tag 这台电脑; right 工作电脑, SELECTED with clean blue outline. Each block contains only an original abstract grayscale screen graphic, not streaming content, plus subtle local/peer glyph. Fine neutral joining edge. Below screen blocks a quiet caption 另一台电脑在本机右侧. No giant OS logos, wallpapers, account avatars or ruler pseudo-measurements.
At canvas bottom, a compact four-direction chooser around 本机, with 右侧 selected. Quiet text 拖动或选择方向，只调整两台主屏的相对位置。 The core canvas isn't filled with safety paragraphs.
Right contextual panel: heading 工作电脑, secondary 已登记设备. Small status line 已连接 · 仅通信 and separate 输入未开启. Section 键鼠协同, explanation 先检查本机权限，再由双方分别确认。 ONE solid blue primary button 检查本机键鼠权限. Section 接收控制 with plain text 由另一台电脑单独允许. No fake toggled on switches. Thin divider, text links 设备与权限详情 and 连接诊断. Small footer 文本、文件尚未接通. No raw certificate paths/tokens/logs in the normal view.
Bottom of app a thin quiet information strip 本机鼠标与手势预览可从「快捷键」进入。 Never show global gestures enabled.
Outside app frame small precise caption Linko / 屏跃 · 拓扑首页视觉提案 and 设备与状态为设计示例，非运行截图.
Do not add accounts, VIP, charts, file-transfer progress, terminals, mobile controls, audio routing, remote live workspace or other implemented-feature claims. The result must feel like refined useful desktop software, not a wireframe or a SaaS template.
